Yamagata Genshirō Masakiyo, Asahina Suruga-no-kami Nobuoki and his son Nobuyoshi, Imafuku Tanba, Imafuku Zenzūrō, Suganuma Gyōbu-shōyū Sadanao of Damine, Suganuma Izu-no-kami Mitsunao, and others were likewise killed as Ieyasu captured their respective castles. In the end, the vast Takeda territories were entirely annexed by the Oda and Tokugawa houses.
